about: Earned colours for air units, release 2. The art director's palette, 25 November 2026. Our own schemes: none is meant to match a real unit's. Third issue, 04:05Z: the historian's check of 03:51Z and 03:54Z and second pass of 04:01Z are applied (twelve schemes struck and replaced, and the rules that follow from them). A scheme's number never changes; a struck scheme's row is replaced in place. Copied into the game unchanged in substance from art-director/air-colours/unit-colours-palette.json (third issue, 04:05Z); read by Battle/AirUnitColours. The historian's check is owed before it ships on: the rows the brief keeps as near (its section 6) are judged in the stills of the one review round, and the Battle rules card's Earned colours stays off until the art director and the historian pass them.

night.note: on a night finish every earned colour is dulled by this much and the tail pattern is kept to the top half of the fin

patterns.tipped: the tail in the first colour, its top fifth in the second
patterns.bands: five level bands of equal height, first colour, second, first, second, first
patterns.checks: level squares, five to the height of the fin, the first colour at the top front corner
patterns.stripes: six upright stripes of equal width, parallel to the rudder hinge, first colour foremost
patterns.halved: the tail halved on the slant from the fin's top front corner to the rudder's bottom rear corner, first colour above and behind, second below and before
